question_text: The stacked bar chart below shows the breakdown of expenditures (in millions of pesos) for four municipalities: Alaminos, Bani, Dasol, and Infanta. Each bar is divided into three categories: Health, Education, and Infrastructure. Alaminos spent a total of ₱120M (Health: 30M, Education: 50M, Infrastructure: 40M). Bani spent a total of ₱100M (Health: 20M, Education: 40M, Infrastructure: 40M). Dasol spent a total of ₱80M (Health: 10M, Education: 30M, Infrastructure: 40M). Infanta spent a total of ₱90M (Health: 25M, Education: 35M, Infrastructure: 30M). Which municipality allocated the highest percentage of its total expenditure to Health?
